name: Codewhale
description: Rust terminal coding agent that runs on hosted or local models and supports multi-agent roles, skills, hooks and MCP servers.
whatItDoes: Codewhale edits code, runs commands and explains what it changed, either interactively or as a one-off command. Different agent roles can be combined on a task. It works with cloud or local models.
howItWorks: A native binary provides a TUI and a non-interactive exec command. The model provider is connected from inside the app, and behaviour is extended with skills, lifecycle hooks and external tool servers.

requirements.name: Model provider
requirements.description: A hosted provider key or a local model, connected via the in-app provider command

run: codewhale exec "fix the failing tests and explain what changed"
